study type: Capture-recapture surveillance and nested case-control study
outcome: Incidence of neonatal cerebral sinovenous thrombosis (CSVT)
cohort: Newborn infants (n=51) diagnosed with neonatal CSVT in Germany between 2015-2017
finding: The incidence of term and preterm neonatal CSVT was 6.6 (95% confidence interval [CI] 4.4-8.7) per 100,000 live births, and hypoxia was identified as an independent risk factor.
